summary.text: Glenn Bosch is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 30 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 2017 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Bosch lists an occupation of Retired Executive VP, AVI Systems; Co-Owner, Bismarck Larks Baseball Club.
It lists education as AAS, Electronic Technology.
Family is listed as: Married (Julie); 3 children; 7 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Bosch's standing committee assignments as Appropriations and Appropriations - Government Operations Division.
